preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The total sum of weights s is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The given edges form a valid tree (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible diameter, which equals s divided by the number of leaf nodes in the tree, within the required precision.
